events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with both sides suffering significant losses. The war is affecting global oil prices and causing uncertainty in the market. The US is showing its military strength, but its geopolitical power is waning.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war is likely to cause a surge in oil prices, making oil-related ETFs unattractive. On the other hand, gold is often seen as a safe-haven asset during times of uncertainty, making it a good buy.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil price movements and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or gold prices drop

events.title: AI Semiconductor Stocks
events.summary: Nvidia is investing up to $3.2 billion in Corning as part of a massive optical fiber deal with 3 new factories focused on AI. This move is expected to boost Nvidia's AI capabilities and increase its market share.
events.reasoning: Nvidia's investment in Corning is a strategic move to enhance its AI capabilities. This is likely to increase Nvidia's market share and boost its stock price. The semiconductor ETF is also a good buy as it will benefit from the growth of AI-related stocks.

timeFrame.note: Monitor Nvidia's stock price and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when Nvidia's stock price reaches its resistance level

gains.conservativeNote: If Nvidia's stock price rises moderately
